subject: Post-demo: IAM evidence request & next steps (SOC 2 / SSO / SCIM)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jenny Lopez <jenny.lopez@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Tom Burnett <tom.burnett@acmehealth.com>, dev.patel@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: IAM evidence request & next steps (SOC 2 / SSO / SCIM)

Thanks again for your time today — great conversation and appreciate the detailed questions from the security and infra teams. Quick recap and the items we discussed so you can share internally: 

1) SOC 2 + compliance posture
- We are SOC 2 Type II in scope for our hosted API and control plane; attached is a one-page summary of the report (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf). We run annual audits and can coordinate NDA/TA review if you need the full report.

2) Identity & Access Management (what you asked for)
- SSO/SAML: We support SAML 2.0 IdP integrations (Okta, AzureAD, OneLogin). Sample metadata and SP configuration screenshot attached (sso_saml_config-screenshot.png).
- SCIM: We support SCIM 2.0 for group & user provisioning; provisioning logs available on request (we can produce a short export).
- RBAC & Admin controls: Role templates (admin, billing, read-only, developer) plus custom role assignment — audit logging of role changes retained for 12 months by default.

3) Next steps / asks from Acme Health
- Please confirm which items you want as evidence (full SOC 2, SAML metadata, SCIM logs, admin role change logs).
- If you want SCIM logs or more detailed SAML metadata, let us know the time window and we'll generate exports.
- If procurement/security prefers, we can start your vendor security questionnaire in parallel — I can open the questionnaire in SecureExchange and invite your team.

Proposed immediate next steps:
- Jenny: confirm evidence scope and who from your security team will own ingestion (it sounded like Tom).
- We’ll prepare the requested artifacts and aim to deliver the initial pack within 48 business hours.

Feel free to reply here or book time on my calendar: https://calendly.com/marissa-redwood/30m

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (650) 555-0123

--
Attachment: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)
Attachment: sso_saml_config-screenshot.png (PNG, 420KB)

Hi Marissa — thanks for the thorough recap and the attachments. Quick answers from our side: 

- For evidence, we need: SOC 2 summary + bridging statement (if available), SAML metadata and SP config, and the last 30 days of SCIM provisioning logs for a sample user set. We may request RBAC change logs if anything jumps out.
- Tom (security lead) will own the ingestion and review. Tom — can you confirm preferred format for SCIM logs (CSV vs. JSON) and whether we should provide an example user list?
- Procurement: we’ll want to kick off the vendor questionnaire — please invite procurement@acmehealth.com to the secure exchange.

If you can get the initial pack by Wednesday EOD (PST) that would be ideal. Happy to hop on a quick follow-up if there are any technical blockers.

Thanks,
Jenny Lopez
Head of IT Security, Acme Health
Jenny.Lopez@acmehealth.com

- SOC 2: one-page summary + statement on any carve-outs (attached). If you need the auditor report we’ll coordinate NDA.
- SAML: SP metadata and step-by-step config notes (screenshot attached).
- SCIM: sample export (last 30 days) in CSV; we can also provide JSON if preferred.
- RBAC logs: we’ll pull the last 90 days of admin role-change events and redact personal data where appropriate.

Internal note: looping in Dev (dev.patel) to generate SCIM and RBAC exports and to redact PII as needed. Dev — can you produce the CSV SCIM export for the window 2026-07-10 to 2026-08-09 and the RBAC role-change log by EOD Wed 8/11? If there are any issues with redaction or export size we’ll escalate.

Jenny/Tom — I’ll upload the artifacts to the Drive link and share via SecureExchange (DocuSign/SSO protected link). Once you’ve reviewed we can move forward with your vendor questionnaire and procurement items.

Best,
Marissa
